character: fat male honeybee drone, amber and brown, barrel belly, honey-smeared from frame one; exactly six legs, front pair as arms; two thirds of frame height
cast: exactly three worker bees in white aprons and caps, purple, teal, orange; the aprons stay on all clip; they work large at the lens, never in the background, never talk
motion_rule: the drone is the subject of every window, the bees add to his move, never replace it; no window ends in a pose; the camera moves in every window, shot size never repeats
props: three spoons of honey; a jar he empties on himself; pillows that burst into feathers; honey runs off him nonstop, a rope of it in every window
environment: honeycomb bedroom at noon, blue sky, direct sun, hard shadows; bed buried in white pillows

audio.delivery: lazy smug male voice, native Russian stress, unhurried
audio.pronunciation: доход is do-HOD, stress on the last syllable, never DO-hod
audio.pacing: one phrase from 0.6 to 3.6, no breath at any join, nothing said after 3.6
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: he kicks a pillow into the lens, blanking it, honey flying off his belly
he sinks his honeyed body deeper into the pillows, a bee driving a loaded spoon into his mouth
he throws both forelegs open across the whole frame, honey ropes flying off them
he heaves his body off the pillows and drops it, the bed bouncing him twice, two bees riding the pillows up and down with spoons at his mouth
he rolls onto his back, his belly wobbling the whole width of the frame
he snatches the jar off a bee and upends it over his face, honey pouring into the lens
he hammers both forelegs into the burst pillow, punching feathers up into the lens, his body rolling with every hit, a feather coat sticking to his honey
he launches his body off the pillows onto the nearest bee and pins her down, both crashing down together, the other two piling in at the lens
he kicks out, they catch the leg and sweep him over, his body flipping, pillows flying
he lands on his back and bridges, thrashing, while they twist his foreleg into an armbar, a bee riding his belly at the lens
his eyes bulge, he groans through the choke, his belly bucking the bed, honey squirting from under him
timeline.c: macro on the eyes, pushes in

timeline.a: his palm crashes down on the bed twice, tapping out, honey splashing up
his palm slides at the lens and fills the frame, honey draining through the fingers, which go limp

must_appear: three bees in aprons and caps feeding him from spoons; aprons on through the whole fight; the sweep, the armbar, the choke; his bulging eyes; his palm slapping the bed; the last frame is his honeyed palm filling the screen
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dim light, static camera, cuts, a talking head, the drone motionless or lying still, bees standing in a row, bees posing, costume change, wrestling singlets, more than three bees, the bees out of frame, subtitles, text overlay, watermark, English speech, voice-over, the phrase repeated, any word after 3.6, extra legs, deformed anatomy, floating objects
